prerequisites: Familiarity with linear algebra (in finite dimensions) and probability (with finitely many outcomes) at the level of a first Bachelors course.
Mathematical maturity for discussing precise mathematical statements and rigorous proofs.

learning_outcomes.text: Learn fundamental concepts, algorithms, and results in quantum information and computation.
Know the theoretical model of quantum information and computation.
Generalize computer science concepts to the quantum setting.
Design and analyze quantum algorithms and protocols for a variety of computational problems.
Be prepared for an advanced course or a research or thesis project in this area.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of quantum computing: quantum bits, states and operations
The power of quantum entanglement: nonlocal games
Entanglement as a resource: superdense coding and teleportation
Quantum computing with oracles: Deutsch-Jozsa, Bernstein-Vazirani, Simon
Quantum Fourier transform and phase estimation
Grover's search algorithm and beyond: how to solve SAT on a quantum computer?
From no cloning to quantum money: a peek at quantum cryptography
assessment_rules: Credits are awarded upon passing the written exam. The final written module exam has a duration of 180 minutes.
